verdict.rationale: Conta Simples is a regulated Brazilian fintech whose core product is a business bank account with corporate and virtual card issuance, Pix, boletos and credit. Those financial services are delivered by the licensed institution itself, so self-hosting the core product is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence covers only a hosted API (OAuth client credentials, card and statement endpoints) and shows no self-hostable distribution that would make the axis apply.
